info.title: Tabula
info.description:
Tabula archives the posts of social media accounts (X, Bluesky, Reddit) that
its users choose to track, and lets them browse and export the archive.

* Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a session token from
  `POST /api/auth/login` or Google sign-in.
* Self-registered users must be enabled by an admin before they can track.

get.description: Readiness — checks the database; 503 when it is unreachable.
Current build plus the URLs integrations need. Requires authentication.

post.description: Exchange email + password for a bearer token.
Self-service sign-up (if enabled). New users can't track until an admin enables them.

patch.description: Change your display name or password (the current password is required if you have one).

get.description: Tells the login page which options to render.

post.description: Start Google sign-in. `link` requires a session; send the browser to the returned URL.
Finish Google sign-in with the code from Google's redirect; returns a session token.
Link the Google account from Google's redirect to the signed-in user.

delete.description: Unlink Google from the signed-in user (they must have a password).

get.description: Every account. Users waiting to be enabled come first.

patch.description: Rename, (de)activate, enable tracking, change role or set a password.

delete.description: Delete an account and its trackings (archived posts are kept).

get.description: Platforms users may track and the scan-frequency limits.

post.description: Start tracking an account. A new account's history is backfilled in the background.

patch.description: Change the scan frequency, or pause/resume scanning.

delete.description: Stop tracking. The archive is kept and resumes if anyone tracks the account again.

post.description: Scan within a minute instead of waiting for the schedule (works while paused).

200.description: The archive (with the same filters as list_posts) as a download.

post.description: Save a login captured with `python -m app.tools.capture_session`.

HTTPBearer.description: A session token from POST /api/auth/login (or Google sign-in).
